description: A Windows XP desktop scene showing a legacy VB business application. The desktop environment is an authored stylistic reconstruction; the application screenshot is from a produced upstream asset (XTRA-11). This is not a documentary photograph.

sources.sha256_note: See build.json for the exact hash at build time.
sources.relationship: source creative brief (VISUAL cue at line 693)
sources.content_used: The visual direction: 'An old Windows XP machine in an office setting, running a VB6 app. The wallpaper is Bliss. The form has that very specific VB6 look -- gray controls, 3D borders.'

sources.relationship: historical original from a produced upstream asset; uniformly scaled via Pillow LANCZOS, not cropped
sources.upstream_provenance: INVOICE-IT for Windows v2.06 (Eastern Digital Resources, 1993). Internet Archive Software Library automated emulator screenshot. See XTRA-11 evidence/source.json for the full provenance record.
sources.vb_provenance: Publisher documentation: 'Recompiled program using Visual BASIC 2.0'; requires VBRUN200.DLL. This is VB 2.0, not VB6.

authored_additions: Windows XP Luna-style desktop with plain blue background (no Bliss wallpaper)
XP-style taskbar with Start button, application button, system clock
XP Luna-style window chrome (blue title bar, control buttons) around the application
Monitor bezel framing (thin dark border around the desktop area)

editorial_decisions.rationale: No documentary photo of a Windows XP machine running a documented VB6 application was found with clear provenance and permitted reuse. The producer approved an explicitly labeled reconstruction.
The Bliss wallpaper rights are unclear. A plain/generic XP desktop blue background is used instead.

XTRA-11 (INVOICE-IT for Windows) is used as the on-screen application. Its VB provenance is documented via the publisher's own files (Visual Basic 2.0, VBRUN200.DLL). Note: this is VB 2.0, not VB6 as the script states.
